description.example: Accepts SKU and quantity; validates stock.

assignedTo.description: Slug of the dev agent that claimed the task.

blocked.description: Task blocked waiting on a decision or a dependency.

blockedOrigin.description: The ORIGIN of the block (ADR 0020/0038), when known. `null` for every Phase 4a block — only the QA Lead (Phase 8b) fills it in.

gateStatus.description: Where the task's PR is in the gate pipeline: QA, then SecOps, then the user. `null` while no PR is open.

gateCorrectionCount.description: How many correction rounds the gates have already requested.

description.example: As a buyer, I want to gather items before paying.

example: The cart accepts up to 50 items
The response stays under 200 ms at p95

businessRuleIds.description: Business rules covered. This is where rule→story coverage is computed in `GET /projects/:id/coverage`.

moduleIds.description: Modules from the `module_map` that the story touches. A story with no module, or with a non-existent module, becomes an architecture pending item.

proposedReady.description: The PO finished the story and it's waiting on the user's decision (Phase 12c — RN-048). Coexists with `status: "draft"`: it is a proposal, not a state. Always `false` in a project in `auto` mode.

returnedReason.example: DoD too generic — spell out the acceptance criteria.
returnedReason.description: Why the user returned the story to the PO. `null` when it was never returned.

description.example: Above that, the addition is refused with 409.

adrs.description: ADRs that apply: the cross-cutting ones (no module declared) plus the ones that cite this agent's module.

securityRelevant.description: Flagged by the Architect. Becomes an informative checklist in SecOps's verdict — there's no line-by-line correlation, and claiming there were would misrepresent the depth of the check.

403.description: Service token missing or different from the shared one.

404.description: Session, project, or resource not found.
